rows.title: No provider confirms the exact all-in-one job
rows.detail: No retrieved source confirms this exact stuck trip-lever extraction plus storage-unit ceiling restoration, nor current availability or acceptance.
rows.action: Use the shortlist as inquiry leads only; obtain one written combined scope and schedule before claiming a provider can do the job.

rows.title: Supplied quote amounts are owner reports, not verified prices
rows.detail: The $614/$550/$135 amounts and scopes came from the owner; no quote documents or contractor confirmations were supplied. Earlier canonical pages suppressed the amounts, preventing the requested comparison.
rows.action: Show supplied amounts in an owner-reported column, leave independently verified amounts blank, and requote one identical scope.

rows.title: The three estimates are not like-for-like
rows.detail: Replacement, lever/plug/spout-diverter, and handle adjustment are different scopes. “Spout/diverter” may not mean the waste-and-overflow assembly.
rows.action: Annotate parts and access/restoration assumptions before comparing prices.

rows.title: No supplied quote explicitly prices ceiling opening/restoration
rows.detail: Silence about drywall is not proof of exclusion, but no combined plumbing-plus-restoration price is on file.
rows.action: Obtain a written fallback price with opening, patch/panel, texture, paint, cleanup and permit assumptions.

rows.title: Quote validity and current pricing are unconfirmed
rows.detail: The supplied date is 2026-08-30; no validity period or current requote was supplied.
rows.action: Ask each provider to confirm validity or issue a current written quote.

rows.title: B + C-36 does not automatically prove drywall self-performance
rows.detail: Earlier pages said B + C-36 “covers both trades directly.” Official C-9/BPC §7057 sources require an appropriate contract/classification structure; C-36 is plumbing, C-9 is drywall.
rows.action: Name the restoration party and license in the contract; ask whether work is self-performed or subcontracted.

rows.title: SF Building Group is B-only on the checked record
rows.detail: #1106131 shows B, not C-36. Plumbing must be appropriately licensed/subcontracted; the site also emphasizes larger planned projects.
rows.action: Do not label it a plumber; identify the C-36 and restoration parties and confirm small-job acceptance.

rows.title: HARP/24-7 is B-2, not B or C-36
rows.detail: #1105133 is B-2 only. BPC §7057.5 requires three unrelated trades and restricts structural work and plumbing-system replacement/substantial alteration.
rows.action: Do not group it with multi-trade B licensees or treat it as an automatic plumbing-plus-drywall fit.

rows.title: Kenneth Asire Plumbing is bond-suspended
rows.detail: #1027286 is suspended for contractors-bond suspension; recorded bond cancellation is 2026-08-16. CSLB notes a replacement bond may not yet be processed.
rows.action: Exclude from the active shortlist; recheck the official record before any reconsideration.

rows.title: Advanced Plumbing carries a future-suspension warning
rows.detail: #1009195 is current and active but CSLB warns it may be suspended at a future date for an unresolved final liability.
rows.action: Review the official warning and recheck before engagement; do not infer the underlying merits.

rows.title: D G Construction has a complaint-disclosure link
rows.detail: CSLB ComplaintDisclosure links to CitationViolationDisclosure for citation 2 2022 002099 (03/23/2023, FOR DISCLOSURE ONLY PER B&P CODE 7124.6), which publishes the violation: Business & Professions Code 7114.A — Aided and abetted non-licensee, while #297604 also certifies WC exempt (no employees).
rows.action: Hold D G Construction outside the priority hiring order on the strength of the disclosed B&P §7114.A citation.

rows.title: Save-On-Interior and Bay Area Plumbing share address/phone, not proven ownership
rows.detail: #749536 (B + C-36) and #757796 (C-36) share a registered street address and phone. CSLB does not establish common control or which entity would contract.
rows.action: Confirm the legal contracting entity and license used on any quote; do not merge the identities.

rows.title: Portola Plumbing Services identity is unresolved
rows.detail: The name appears in prior research/Yelp excerpts, but no exact CSLB legal entity/license match was confirmed.
rows.action: Leave license, phone, status and expiry blank; use the official lookup before adding it to a shortlist.

rows.title: Yelp business pages were blocked; ratings/counts are blank
rows.detail: Yelp business pages returned HTTP 403 again on 2026-11-10, so no Yelp numeric ratings/counts are published. Direct BBB and Angi profiles were retrieved on 2026-11-10 for qualitative/complaint checks with numeric ratings kept blank.
rows.action: Keep review observations labeled by retrieval method; request direct references and a current occupied-unit plan.

rows.title: Rapid Flow wall-opening account is adjacent, not exact-job proof
rows.detail: A Yelp-indexed account describes tub-plug retrieval through a wall opening/pipe cut. It does not establish this trip-lever job, ceiling restoration or a current protocol.

rows.title: Ace occupied-home review is old and not a current protocol
rows.detail: An indexed older account mentions masking/booties; the business page was blocked and no current written containment plan was retrieved.
rows.action: Request the provider’s current occupied-unit plan and insurance evidence.

rows.title: Heise’s case studies are self-published and contain a 404 template block
rows.detail: Heise's project pages (#163802 Ingleside, #158154 Mission, #176011 Marina, and Panhandle #171358) are self-published summaries containing an embedded 404 block, and company pages display inconsistent review-volume claims (1,600+ vs 1,700+ vs 1,840 vs 2,000+).
rows.action: Treat as adjacent self-published evidence only; ask for a direct reference, exact access location and named restoration party.

rows.title: Heise’s license has no B or C-9
rows.detail: CSLB #1089561 lists A/C-10/C-20/C-36, not B or C-9. The company advertises plumbing-access and ceiling patching, but the person performing restoration, licensing and contract structure for this job remain unconfirmed.
rows.action: Ask the contractor to identify the restoration party and confirm the appropriate licensing and contract structure for the actual scope.

rows.title: Bernal Hill is a restoration partner, not a plumber
rows.detail: #995163 shows B + C-9 and advertises patch/paint/texture/build-back, but no C-36.
rows.action: Use only for the restoration leg under a lawful combined contract; verify the plumber separately.

rows.title: We Do, Ayoob & Peery and SF Building Group emphasize larger/commercial work
rows.detail: Official sites position these firms around design-build, commercial wet-side systems or larger planned projects. Small occupied-unit repair acceptance is unconfirmed.
rows.action: Confirm minimum job size and availability before prioritizing; do not infer refusal.

rows.title: Job-specific permit determination is still open
rows.detail: SF.gov requires a permit before cutting/replacing pipes; §104.2 exemptions are conditional. No DBI written determination for this exact scope was supplied.
rows.action: Get the permit answer in writing before work; do not assume exemption or infer a permit-free path.

rows.title: SF Plumbing Code §104.2 is now retrieved; earlier “unverified” flag is corrected
rows.detail: Operative §104.2 text was directly retrieved again on 2026-11-08 in zero-based chunk 13; chunk 14 contains §104.5. Earlier chunk numbering was off by one. The publisher disclaims definitive authority; confirm job applicability with DBI.
rows.action: Keep conditional exemptions and publisher limitation visible; do not infer a permit-free path.

rows.title: Access-panel dimensions remain unverified
rows.detail: IAPMO chapter 4 redirected to a members-only login; no operative 12-inch access-panel text was retrieved. A SF code-amendments URL returned 404.
rows.action: Leave dimensions blank and ask DBI/contractor for the applicable written requirement.

rows.title: Official fee category is not a confirmed job price
rows.detail: Table 1A-C lists Category 1P at $290 and separate inspection rates, but the job category and whether quotes include fees are unconfirmed.
rows.action: Budget fees separately only after DBI/quote confirmation; do not add them blindly or present them as total cost.

rows.title: Building age, paint and suspect materials are unknown
rows.detail: Lead RRP and asbestos controls are conditional. No age/material assessment or photographs were supplied.
rows.action: Screen before disturbing finishes; use qualified professionals if suspect material is present.

rows.title: Storage-unit authority and affected tenancies are unconfirmed
rows.detail: The space below may be a separate unit/common area; ownership, consent and notice recipients were not supplied.
rows.action: Confirm authority and give each affected tenant the required notice before scheduling.

rows.title: No reference photographs or exact assembly model were supplied
rows.detail: Analysis is description-based; manufacturer instructions are model-specific and cannot identify the stuck unit.
rows.action: Collect photos/model/size before finalizing parts and access strategy.

rows.title: Workers-comp “exempt” is not general-liability proof
rows.detail: Several CSLB records certify no employees. That does not establish general-liability coverage or coverage for subcontractors.
rows.action: Request current certificates for every onsite party and match the legal entity.

rows.detail: Fast Response shows four address variants: CSLB lists 236 W POTRAL AVE #459 (typo), company /faq lists mailing 236 W Portal Ave #259 (94127), /faq footer lists San Francisco, CA 94118, and BBB lists 4444 Geary Blvd #203 (94118); additionally /plumbing-repair-and-replacement returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-10.

rows.title: Save-On-Interior has 2015–2016 CSLB miscellaneous entries

rows.detail: Legacy GEMS source/evidence/docs/downloads remain preserved and are not part of the repair analysis.

rows.title: Parallel sessions produced duplicate and conflicting bathtub routes
rows.detail: Earlier root/bathtub/bathtub-overflow/bathroom-overflow/trip-lever/docs routes disagreed on counts, classifications, amounts and permit/code claims. Main now uses redirect stubs and archives.

rows.title: GitHub Pages status has lagged/errored across rapid merges
rows.detail: Pages API currently reports build_type "legacy" with source branch main and path "/", while the repository also has a successful Actions Pages workflow. A prior successful build is not proof of the new merge commit. Retrieved live on 2026-11-10: the legacy Pages builder ERRORED for three commits that day (caab44e, a510682, b30f89d) while the Actions runs for those same commits reported success, and PUT /repos/.../pages with build_type=workflow returns HTTP 403 "Resource not accessible by integration". The staged closure is 21 files and COORDINATION.md and pyproject.toml both return GitHub Pages 404 live, so the workflow artefact - not the whole repository root - is what is currently served.
rows.action: After this integration merge, verify the specific workflow run, Pages build commit and cache-busted live content. Owner action: set Pages > Build and deployment > Source to "GitHub Actions" in the repository UI, because the available automation token cannot (HTTP 403). Until that is done, a legacy build that stops erroring would publish the entire repository root, including internal coordination and audit records.

rows.title: No provider has been contacted or booked
rows.detail: This research did not submit forms, call providers, confirm availability, negotiate price or create an appointment.
rows.action: Use the ready-to-send scope sheet for inquiries; record responses before updating fit/availability fields.

rows.title: PR #33 was closed unmerged and its branch deleted
rows.detail: The 22-license audit/analysis commit remains accessible by SHA and was reviewed; it is not merged over the newer main baseline.
rows.action: Preserve the commit reference and incorporate independently rechecked facts; do not silently discard the parallel work.

rows.title: The hire ranking is editorial decision support, not a verified performance rating
rows.detail: The ranked page orders candidates with a transparent weighted score built only from official CSLB fields, company-published service statements and the owner-supplied quote wording. No provider was contacted and no reference, completion record or verified review was obtained, so the order cannot be read as proof that one firm performs better than another.
rows.action: Use the ranking to decide who to call first, then replace the score with documented answers, a written combined scope and a fixed price once providers respond.

rows.title: Clever Plumbing & Rooter was licensed on 2026-09-04
rows.detail: The CSLB record shows an issue date of 2026-09-04 with a workers-compensation exemption (certified no employees). The licence is current and active, but there is no tenure or published evidence for delicate occupied-unit work.
rows.action: Keep it below the shortlist and treat any quote as unproven until references and insurance are produced.

rows.title: Three earlier-session pull requests remain open and unmerged
rows.detail: Nine earlier-session pull requests remain open and unmerged on GitHub as of 2026-11-10 (#7, #35, #38, #39, #44, #49, #51, #53, #63); main already reflects PRs #54–#62.
rows.action: Owner decision: close them, or have the owning session rebase onto the current main. This session did not touch another session's pull request.

rows.title: Repository hygiene: four case-colliding run cards and stale session branches
rows.detail: AGENTS.md and PROJECT_PROMPT.md both require a single JSON run card, but four are tracked with four different schemas: RUN_CARD.json (4,530 bytes, keys run_card_version/protocol/holdout_dti), run_card.json (5,749 bytes, keys competition/deadline_utc/difference_from_prior_repo_work), evidence/run_card.json and docs/evidence/run_card.json (2,695 bytes each, identical schema, keys raster_sha256/uniqueness). All four belong to the archived geothermal project. Separately, 38 arena/* remote branches exist alongside main on origin as of 2026-11-10.
rows.action: Keep one run card for the archived project and archive the other three, and delete merged session branches. Neither affects the published dashboard.

rows.title: Independent auditor source allowlist omitted three official primary domains
rows.detail: The prior audit counted four rows as lacking a recognized source: SF code publisher American Legal, Ayoob & Peery and Bernal Hill Drywall. The rows did contain source links; the independent allowlist omitted amlegal.com, ayoobpeery.com and bernalhilldrywall.com. This was a classifier gap, not permission to publish unsupported rows.
rows.action: Use the canonical source registry kinds and explicit official-primary domains in a stricter row audit; retain the prior audit as history.

rows.detail: Atlas shows CSLB phone (650) 871-9863, website phone (415) 849-2346, and BBB primary phone (415) 845-9199, plus 1 answered 10/29/2024 BBB $295 line-flush/warranty dispute.

rows.detail: The CSLB B page quotes an older version of BPC §7057. The current California Legislature page was separately retrieved and controls the contract-limit summary; the official Fast Facts sheet is a summary, not a job-specific ruling.

rows.title: Earlier executive-summary redirect stubs point to a superseded project mirror
rows.detail: BATHTUB_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md and EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_bathtub.md still describe project/summary.json as authoritative. The canonical build now reads overflow-integration/data and generates OVERFLOW_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md. The old files remain preserved but their wording is stale.

rows.title: No verified comparable all-in price exists for ranking
rows.detail: The three supplied amounts are owner-reported and cover different scopes. No provider has confirmed a current combined plumbing/access/restoration price. Ranking therefore uses source-checked fit evidence, not invented price scores.

rows.title: Heise's BBB B- rating, dissolved prior #787733, and misfiled Instagram complaint
rows.detail: BBB shows a B- unaccredited profile for Heise's Plumbing Inc carrying superseded CSLB #787733 (which CSLB confirms expired 03/31/2023 and was canceled/SoS dissolved 02/12/2025), 1 negative 08/14/2024 customer review (Kay S), and 1 unanswered 07/05/2026 complaint whose text is an unrelated misfiled Instagram/Meta complaint.
rows.action: Contract strictly with active #1089561 TARO GROUP INC dba HEISES PLUMBING (never dissolved #787733); ignore the misfiled Meta complaint while still vetting restoration licensing.

rows.title: SFBC §106A.2(10) fire-resistive ceiling assembly check for below-ceiling cut/patch
rows.detail: Direct reading of SFBC §106A.2(10) on 2026-11-10 shows minor interior plaster or wallboard repair is permit-exempt ONLY except when part of a fire-resistive assembly; whether the ceiling separating the unit from the storage area below is fire-rated is unconfirmed.
rows.action: Have the contractor/DBI confirm whether the storage ceiling is fire-rated (e.g., Type X gypsum) before cutting and preserve fire rating upon restoration.

rows.title: Permit Center closed 2026-11-11, so the permit determination slips to 2026-11-12
rows.detail: The sf.gov plumbing and mechanical permit page displayed a live banner on 2026-11-10: "City offices will be closed on Wednesday, November 11 for Veterans Day." The Permit Center help desk (628-652-4900) and the second-floor counter at 49 South Van Ness are therefore unavailable on 2026-11-11, and the same page commits to "We will contact you within 2 business days" for help-desk voicemail. This is a scheduling constraint on obtaining the permit or exemption determination, not a change in the rule.
rows.action: Do not plan a DBI call, counter visit or contractor permit application for 2026-11-11. The next business day is Thursday 2026-11-12; a help-desk question left on 2026-11-10 should draw a response by 2026-11-13. Ask the contractor to state its permit position in writing before any pipe is cut or covered.

rows.title: Archived workflow pushes to a hardcoded branch belonging to a session that ended on 2026-11-04
rows.detail: .github/workflows/gems-pipeline.yml line 59 contains "git push origin HEAD:arena/d7026453-korea8" - a fixed session branch name baked into a workflow on main. That session's branch is historical. The workflow is workflow_dispatch only, so it does not run on push, but if anyone dispatches it, it will commit generated evidence to an unrelated session's branch. This is a live cross-session hazard given that many sessions share this repository.
rows.action: Parameterise the target branch (for example ${{ github.ref_name }}) or delete the archived workflow. Owner decision: this file belongs to the archived geothermal project and is outside the bathtub deliverable's scope, so it was flagged rather than edited.

rows.title: 14.05 MB of GeoTIFF is committed although AGENTS.md says the data is never committed
rows.detail: AGENTS.md line 39 states that competition data "is restored on a GitHub Actions runner and never committed", yet 16 .tif files totalling 14,052,602 bytes are tracked: registry/lattice_s5.tif, nine registry/focus9/GEMSDOE*.tif, submissions/korea8-h1-stepover-relay-prior-*.tif, data/templates/GEMS-grid-template.tif, and duplicated pairs under downloads/ with docs/downloads/. AGENTS.md separately documents registry/focus9/ and lattice_s5.tif as intentionally preserved bytes, so the file contradicts itself rather than being simply wrong. All of it belongs to the archived geothermal project.
rows.action: Owner decision: either correct the AGENTS.md sentence to describe what is actually committed, or move the rasters to release assets or Git LFS. No effect on the published dashboard, which stages only its 21 linked public files.
